description: This file contains ARM assembly code for flushing the entire data cache (D-cache) on ARMv7 architecture. It is specifically tailored for certain Broadcom devices with known bootloader issues that leave caches enabled, requiring this custom cache management routine.

methods.name: v7_flush_dcache_all
methods.description: Entry point for flushing all data caches at the ARMv7 level, implemented in ARM assembly.
